name: com.andreleandrodev.mihordeanimation
description: Drives MiVertexAnimation clips from a MiHordeTraffic crowd, from one manager rather than a script on every entity. Bodies register once and are never dispatched again: the per frame work is a transform job and a Burst scan that hands back only the handful of bodies whose animation should change, so a crowd of thousands standing still costs nothing at all. Ships with proximity attacks, where every body that comes within range of the target plays a clip once and sits out a cooldown.
